notes.title: DarkFairyTale Version 1.2 – The Whisperer is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, Pinocchios!



We’re excited to bring you a major update with Dark Fairy Tale V1.2 – The Whisperer! From September 16 through the Steam Autumn Sale, enjoy a variety of colorful discounts – a perfect chance to grab the game! Thank you again for all your support! 🎉


Update Highlights 📢👾 New Content
New Tarot Character & Dream Challenges: Unlock the Tarot Card · World and Tarot Dream levels. Consuming the Tarot Card · World grants the Time Stop ability.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/947e7ae765d6a6f665e701619ef453f4e0207edc.png"]

Abyssal Slime gains the Split skill.

Entwined Vine Spirit gains the Self-Destruct skill.

Monster Raids: In Shallow and Endless Dreams on Normal / Hard / Nightmare, different types of monster groups may appear randomly.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/9bcb9c414d183aa184136a1f60837632d7c992f3.gif"]

New Boss – The Whisperer: Challenge after completing floor 15 in Normal / Hard / Nightmare. Defeat it for generous rewards. It may also appear randomly in Endless Dreams.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/bd26708d8b982c92d4d2ca2a7995d4d027106b61.png"]

The bundle contains:
DarkFairytale: Dreamland Survivors + DLC DarkFairytale – More Eggs

KAKU: Ancient Seal + Launch Bonus + Official Soundtrack
Add them to your library !ːsteammockingː


At the same time, we’re thrilled to announce a special crossover bundle featuring Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors and Astro Prospector. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59083/Dark_Fairy_Tale__Astro_Prospector/"][/dynamiclink]Different styles, the same excitement — if you love Astro Prospector, you definitely won’t want to miss this bundle with Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors!



✨We’re excited to present not just one, but two special bundles packed with premium adventures! Dive in now and experience three unique worlds of adventure!ːsteamhappyː



overview of the three games
KAKU: Ancient Seal
An Open world Action adventure combining exploration with puzzles and dynamic combat. Go on a journey across a sprawling continent as Kaku, a boy tasked to restore balance to the land. Brave the four elemental regions with the help of Piggy, his powerful companion and conquer their lords.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179580/KAKU_Ancient_Seal/"][/dynamiclink]
Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
This is a top-down, auto-shooting roguelike that can be played entirely one-handed. Players take on the role of Pinocchio, fallen into a nightmare, collecting forbidden Dream Eggs that grant ever-changing offensive and survival abilities. Slay twisted fairy tale creatures in endless nightmares!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288300/Dark_Fairy_Tale_Dreamland_Survivors/"][/dynamiclink]
Astro Prospector
Astro Prospector is an incremental bullet hell about mining cofferoids and fighting SpaceCorp. Collect resources, upgrade your ship and become unstoppable. Return AstroCoffee to humanity!

notes.title: Patch V1.0.4.1574
notes.notes:
Patch V1.0.4.1574


📦【Gallery Feature Added】
Monster Page: Displays monster appearances and info, while tracking your total kills.

Item Page: Shows detailed information of all items and records how many times they’ve been devoured.

Achievement Page: Syncs with Steam Achievements, you could easy to check your progress.

Records & Dream Page: Review your best runs and browse detailed statistics from past games.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/bb45a7a2fd5fd803366cd1745c96238afab14ecc.png"]
⚖️【Tarot Effect Adjustments】
Tarot Card · Hanged Man: Effect changed from “Invert the Dream World” to “Invert the Player,” and damage immunity chance increased by 20%.

Tarot Card · Lovers: The player and clones no longer have attribute changes.

Tarot Card · Strength: Maximum charge effect increased from 300% to 500%.

Tarot Card · Hierophant: The number of initial and simultaneously existing Empowered Auras has been increased to 3.
📌【Dream Egg Adjustments】
Burn / Corrosion / Curse effects can now trigger critical hits even without Dream Eggs.

Blazing Dream Egg: Effect changed from “Burn damage can trigger critical hits” to “Burn critical chance +5%.”

Decayed Dream Egg: Effect changed from “Corrosion damage can trigger critical hits” to “Corrosion critical chance +5%.”

Cursed Dream Egg: Effect changed from “Curse damage can trigger critical hits” to “Curse critical chance +5%.”

The value required to increase explosion chance has been updated — now consuming the first Explosion tag increases the explosion chance to 10%.

Furious Black Swan: Increased bomb-throwing frequency and explosion radius.
👾【Adjustment】
Increased the attack power of the Hypocrite Prince’s Sword.

After defeating Matchstick Selling Girls and Greedy Matchboxes, the dropped matchboxes now yield more Purple and Red Dream Eggs.

In Endless Dream, reduced the item drop rate of special monsters.

Increased monster levels in Endless Mode, adjusted spawn logic for monsters infiltrating the dream, and overall increased stage difficulty.


📬 Contact us — we look forward to your feedback and suggestions!👉Discord Your feedback and support mean the world to us. We'll do our best to keep improving the game and maintain open, positive communication with all of you.

notes.title: Demo Version Closure Notice
notes.notes:
Dear players,



First of all, we’d like to thank everyone who has played, tested, and supported the Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors demo so far!

Your valuable feedback has helped us improve the game tremendously.



To ensure that all players experience the game closer to its true, updated version, we’ve decided to take the demo offline for now.

The current demo differs significantly from the actual game in gameplay, balance, visuals, and features, and no longer represents what we want new players to see.

We don’t want this version to cause confusion or mislead new players.



We’re continuing to refine the game, add more content, and polish the experience. Please stay tuned for future updates — and feel free to join our community and share your thoughts with us anytime!

Thank you so much for your support and understanding!



— BINGOBELL Team

notes.title: V1.0.4.1240 Update — REBORN
notes.notes:
🧩 Reset & Optimization
1. Dream Realm & Level-Up Rewards

The previous system of obtaining Dream Eggs upon leveling up has been removed. Now, when leveling up, you can directly choose a reward attribute. 54 new upgrade attributes have been added.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/346a16f5a483f5bbcb6afbe0a55825a9df1bc353.png"]

Normal Dream Realms now have selectable difficulty levels. Clearing higher difficulties will grant you more Dream Crystals and Nightmare Sigils.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/08d9eb2532250077b339f28a3392505d75f1f500.png"]

The amount of Nightmare Sigils gained from consuming Dream Eggs has been reduced.

When progressing to the next Dream Realm floor, you will automatically receive a certain number of Nightmare Sigils.

2. Talent Adjustments

There is no longer a limit to the number of Talents you can own — all Talents can now be enhanced simultaneously. Some high-tier Talents will unlock automatically after spending a certain number of Nightmare Sigils.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/309476ca798478812b17f8b49dfe2dbc329fadc4.png"]

The enhancement cost and max level of Talents have been adjusted.

Faction Talents no longer require Nightmare Sigils to enhance. They now consume Dream Crystals instead. Dream Crystals can be obtained after clearing 15 floors in the Deep Dive Dream Realm.

After the update, your Faction Talent levels will be kept. Regular Talent levels will be reset, and the spent Nightmare Sigils will be refunded.


⚖️ Adjustments
Optimized the level-up effects and added new visual effects.

Added a dodge count indicator halo under the protagonist’s feet.

The character’s status panel now displays new stats: main weapon attack speed, HP regeneration, and damage immunity chance (capped at 70%).

Added a shortcut tip for the backpack at the bottom(Q) of the combat interface.

Improved the behavior logic of Enraged Black Swan and Lazy Crystal Shoes, so their projectiles are always thrown at a set distance from the protagonist.

Added two new Talents: Periodic Regeneration and Survivor’s Secret, which boost HP regeneration and damage immunity chance respectively.

In Endless Mode, the Devil’s Bargain now appears every 5 minutes, and the chance for buffs to appear has been increased.

Balance adjustment: the max level cap for the protagonist and tags has been raised to 400.

Projectiles fired by the protagonist now use a single fixed style instead of multiple random ones.

Increased projectile flight speed by 50%.

Hoarder Dream Egg: The 30% pickup radius bonus now converts into base attack power instead — changed from 30% to 20%.

Damage Dream Egg: When taking damage, you gain a shield equal to 10% of max HP for 20 seconds — adjusted to 5 seconds.

Simplified the tutorial for new players.


⚙️ Fixes
Fixed an issue where the main weapon’s attack speed was not taking effect.

Fixed a problem where absorbing a large amount of XP and coins would cause stuttering.

Fixed a bug where the Sun Tarot Card devour effect caused severe lag.

Adjusted the monster damage formula to fix an issue where the protagonist couldn’t deal damage to monsters properly.

Adjusted protagonist and monster stats to fix an issue where attributes did not increase after level 100.

Fixed an issue where the flip progress in Tarot Dream and Random Tarot Dream did not sync properly.

Fixed an issue where the instant-kill effect did not have its trigger chance halved on special monsters.


📬 Contact us — we look forward to your feedback and suggestions!👉Discord

To Player
If this update surprised you or got you curious about what’s coming next,

don’t forget to drop us a review and share your feedback on Steam!

Your support keeps us going — next stop, we keep pushing forward together!

Thank you

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.4.1106
notes.notes:
🧩 \[New]
In Endless Dream Mode, a brand-new NPC — the Demon Chest — will now appear every 3 minutes.

💀 Deal with the Devil:

When you open the Demon Chest, you must pay a certain amount of silver coins for each card you reveal. The cards can grant powerful boons… or risky curses.

🔹 Boon Cards

+1 or +2 to the maximum number of active abilities

+50 Defense or +100 Defense

+100 Max HP or +300 Max HP

+5% or +10% chance to be immune to damage (up to 50% total)

5Reduce monster stat scaling by 15% or 30%

Curse Cards

Increase monster level by 1 or 2

Increase monster movement speed by 3% or 5%

Increase monster HP by 10% or 15%

Lose 200 or 666 silver coins

Gain +2 or +5 Nightmare Sigils

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/9289d1beaf5b5f7bae26f8c042ee919d7aad1d84.png"]
⚖️ \[Adjustments]
Explosions and Mines now use the main character’s critical hit rate to trigger critical damage.

Cursed Paradox and Doom Carnival Dream Eggs can now stack their effects.

Updated art assets for the Sun Stage.

Added a damage immunity function for the main character.

Adjusted Dream Egg prices and fixed decimal point pricing errors.

Optimized the attack sound effects for Aucher, Lancer, and Caster.
⚙️ \[Fix]
Fixed an issue where Branch Dream Eggs could stack infinitely — now, only the highest value within the same branch will be active.

Fixed an issue where activated Dream Eggs did not immediately highlight changes in the character stats panel.

Fixed an issue where picking up Dream Eggs sometimes had no sound effect.

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.4.1045
notes.notes:
⚙️ \[New Features]
Venom Splash:Venom Splash incorrectly triggered 100% Corrosion critical damage.It will now follow the normal crit chance to determine if critical damage occurs.

Corrosion Percentage HP Damage:Corrosion will now only trigger percentage-based HP damage when a Corrosion crit occurs.Additionally, Corrosion percentage damage no longer benefits from critical damage bonuses.
⚖️ \[Build Adjustments]
Explosive: Mine damage now scales with the hero’s explosion stat. Nuke now applies a powerful knockback with its large blast radius. Explosion damage increased.

Tentacle: Stun duration increased to 3.5 seconds.While enemies are stunned, all damage dealt is increased by +25%/50%/75%/100%.

Summon Treant: Stun aura radius doubled.

Greedy Build: EXP pickups now increase in quantity, similar to silver coins.

Pierce: First 3 spawned bullets now gain piercing. Sniper talent’s crit damage bonus adjusted to 50%/100%/150%/200%.

Black Hole / Headshot Instakill: Now also affects special enemies, but with halved chance.
📌\[optimization]
Buffed hero stat gains from devouring Dream Eggs — higher tag levels now grant greater boosts.

Chariot Tarot: Each dodge increases dodge-damage radius by +50%, stacking up to +200%. If no further dodge occurs within 5 seconds, the radius resets.

Nuke Dream Egg: New effect — +50% explosion damage.

Improved visuals/effects when reviving via Revival Dream Egg.

Optimized vertical dodge range (up/down).

Reduced critical hit text size by 30%.

Updated art for The Hierophant Tarot and its associated Dream.

New visual update for Tarot Dream map.

Various sound effect improvements.
🧩 \[New]
NPCs and portals now require the player to approach and press a key to interact.

Shop update: You can now sell items from your inventory, including Dream Eggs and Tarot Cards.

Icon visuals optimized.

Added animated effects to the startup screen.
